checks.questionEn: Can uniform concentration identify either constant velocity?
checks.questionZh: 均匀浓度能确定任一常速度吗？
checks.answerEn: No. With both concentration gradients zero, the advection term vanishes for every velocity. The transport observation cannot distinguish any two constant velocities. A small concentration error or residual therefore cannot certify velocity accuracy. Add spatially informative tracer structure or independent measurements; repeated optimisation cannot supply missing information.
checks.answerZh: 不能。两个浓度梯度都为零时，对所有速度，平流项均为零。输运观测无法区分任意两个常速度，因此浓度误差或残差很小也不能证明速度准确。需要有空间结构的示踪剂或独立测量；重复优化无法提供缺失的信息。
